title: Web export does not include dynamic libraries (index.side.wasm, gdextension, etc.) in loading progress bar
body:
### Tested versions

I'm on a slightly modified (but nothing that touches this) version of Godot 4.7-dev2.

From what I can tell, this was simply never implemented.

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev (8546e822f) - Debian GNU/Linux forky/sid forky on Wayland - X11 display driver, Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (RPL-P) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1360P (16 threads) - 15.31 GiB memory

### Issue description

From what I can tell, a function called `loadDylibs` gets called at some point during initialization and tells the proto-Engine to wait until it's done but the dynamic libraries do not have their sizes recorded in the JSON that the exporter spits out and they appear to be loaded using a completely different code path that doesn't call the `onProgress` function.

This doesn't, strictly speaking, *break* anything, but it does cause the loading screen to appear stuck as it finishes loading `index.wasm` and `index.pck` (8.8 megabytes and 38 megabytes uncompressed, 2.4 and 27 compressed for my project and export templates right now) and then keeps the progress bar at 100% while it downloads `index.side.wasm` (336 megabytes, 82 compressed) and `libspycardsonlinenative.web.template_release.wasm32.wasm` (63 megabytes, 12 compressed).

(I'm building with debug symbols enabled so I can profile it easily, which results in these huge file sizes.)

### Steps to reproduce

1. Export any project with:
  - Platform: web
  - Threads: enabled
  - Extensions: enabled
2. Load it up in a browser with a connection speed slow enough that you can see the loading bar move
3. Observe that the loading bar reaches 100% long before the game starts

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A

~~(I'm going to try to make a PR for this, but I've never touched emscripten's JavaScript before and if someone more experienced can do it in fifteen minutes please feel free to take the reins.)~~ Can't get it to work reliably, so I'm throwing in the towel.
